tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i sgrub dkyil phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa blo gsal 'jug pa bde byed 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// shrī wan saṅgu ru tsa gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥmaṇ+ḍa la pa ri wā ra ye na maḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje yi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs dang dkyil 'khor cho ga'i rim/ /lhan cig bsdebs pa'i bstan chos ngo mtshar can/ /blo gsal 'jug pa bde byed ces bya 'di/ /dang po'i las can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i yid kyis 'dir spel lo/ ༈ /de la 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas rang gzhan smin par byed pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /dang po la slob ma'i rgyud sbyang ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ bsnyen pa bya ba/ sa'i cho ga sta gon du gnas pa dang lnga'i dang po rnams ni dgos pa'i phyogs la/ rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtshor blta'o/ /lnga pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ gnas dben zhing dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying par bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i dbus su las thig dkyil chog ltar btab la/ gtso bo lnga'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / 'khor rnams la zlum por byugs la tshom bu lha grangs dang mthun par bkod/ sa lha'i tshom bu byang shar du bkod pa'i mdun du de nyid kyi gtor ma dang / sgos mchod bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi spyi mchod ni/ dbang ldan du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang / chu gcig kha bskangs te phyogs mtshams rnams su chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa sgor mor bshams/ de'i nang du sgos mchod mar me/

bdug spos zhal zas rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re dang / gtso bo la shar du lhag po gcig rnams bshams/ logs ji ltar 'os par bla ma yi dam gyi bris sku sogs dgram pa'i mdun du/ yi dam chos skyong sogs gang dgos kyi gtor ma dang / de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod/ bum pa gnyis kyi rnam rgyal la bum mtshan nyi ma'i steng du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pa dang / las bum la nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa gdags/ bum pa gnyis gu gul gyis bdug las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas/ yungs kar gyis brab/ nang du bum rdzas sogs bla med spyi dang mthun kha rgyan mgul chings dung chos rdo rje gzungs thag sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams dang slob ma sta gon dgos na'ang / de la dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin ma tshang ba med par bshams/ dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du sngon 'gro gtor ma gcig chus sbyangs/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul ba zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kriṭa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shu n+yā tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod par gyur pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ zhes brjod/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug la/ oṃ da sha dika lo kā pa la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mgron bkug rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ da sha dika a ba s+d+yi te bh+yaḥ phyogs bcu rnam par gnas pa rnams/

e hi a ba s+d+yi bh+yaḥtsa/ tshur byon la rnam par gnas pa'i/ dā+e ba/ lha/ nā ga klu/ yak+ṣa/ gnod sbyin/ gan+dharba/ dri za/ a su ra/ lha min/ ga ru ḍā/ mkha' lding / kin+na ra/ mi'am ci/ ma ho ra ga lto 'phye chen po/ bhū ta/ 'byung po/ pre ta/ yi dwags/ pi sha tsa/ sha za/ un+ma da/ smyo byed/ a pa sma ra/ rjed byed/ osta rnon po/ ra ka a ti bh+yo/ ba liṃ dā pa/ gtor ma 'di bzung la/ ya mi gṛ hi twa/ su kha/ bde ba dang / swa ma na s+ya lā bhi no bha wan+tu/ yid bde ba thob par gyur cig s+d+ya nañtsa ni ru pa dra baṃ ku rban+tu/ nye bar 'tshe ba med par gnas par mdzod/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha ne na/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ a mṛ ta paṇ+ḍi bhuka twa/ bdud rtsi'i zas 'di bzhes shig ma ma sa pa ri bā ra s+ya/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ shan+tiṃ zhi ba dang / kurban+tu/ sasta dge legs su mdzod/ swāhā/ gzhi tshugs/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nyer spyod lnga dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod nas bdud rtsi phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang / /'dir ni kun tu gnas pa dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min nam mkha' lding / /mi'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za dang / /smyo byed dang ni rjed byed dang / /rnon po la sogs pa rnams la/ /gtor ma 'bul gyis bsnams nas kyang / /bde dang yid bde thob gyur cig /gnas 'dir nyer 'tshe med par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyi/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi yi/ /bza' ba la ni longs spyad nas/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje thugs khar bzung la/

swāhā/ rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgos shing / /bstan pa skyong bar zhal bzhes pa/ /'byung po'i bdag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar dang / phyogs skyong ba chen po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang stongs grogs mdzod cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes pa dang / lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la reg la/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ gats+tsha zhes dang rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛṭa hūm̐ phaṭ ces brjod/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor/ yang mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal la/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu zhes dang / slob dpon gyis nang mchod gtor la bigh+nān gyis bsangs/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur me 'od dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ steng thog rim par phub cing rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i nang gi mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su/ aṃ las mchod yon/ paṃ las me tog dhaṃ las bdug spos/ daṃ las mar me/ gaṃ las dri chab/ naṃ las zhal zas/ shaṃ las rol mo/ hūm̐ las mchod rdzas gzhan rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/

sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum dang rol chen bya/ mchod pa'i byin rlabs gzhan rnams la dharmā ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos so/ /de nas zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad spyi dang 'dra bar byas la/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan cing / sems dpa'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang shing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang / dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khum rnag khrag gi rnam pas gshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍ-i dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+ri bhā wa mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥ nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang / sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus par gsal ba'i snying khar pad+ma dang / nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'og min nas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la 'od zer rang gi snying khar bsdu'o/ /de nas/ khams gsum spyod pa las grol mkha' dang mnyam gyur dngos kun ngo bo nyid/ /dag cing zhi la rnam dben mchog zhi 'di ni rnal 'byor pa nyid yul/ /go dka' brtag par dka' la bdag gzhan rab phan khyab cing mtshan ma med/ /rgyal ba'i bde ba mnyam med mnyam sku mi rtog tshul gcig la phyag 'tshal/

/zhes pas phyag bya/ thugs kha nas rang rang gi sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ shrī gu h+ya sa mā dzaḥ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i/ maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra/ dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas/ ar+ghaṃ mchod yon/ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtsho chen po/ s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya 'gro ba'i dam tshig shrī dpal/ ye hūm̐ gis mchod yon dang / de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe sa me tog dhūm̐ pes bdug spos/ a lo kes mar me/ ghan+dhes dri dang / nai wi d+yes zhal zas/ shap+das rol mo rnams phul/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐ zhes gzugs rdo rje ma dang / de bzhin du rū pa'i gnas su/ shap+das sgra rdo rje/ gan+dhes dri rdo rje/ ra sas ro rdo rje/ par+ṣ+yas reg bya rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod/ rdo rje ma lnga'i phyag rgya yongs grags bzhin/ mchod 'phreng bzhin bya/ rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ongs spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/

/byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ongs pa la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa'o/ /de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha rang bzhin gyis dag pa/

sarba dharmā chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa/ swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag nyid rang yin/ chos thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /gnyis pa srung 'khor bsgom pa la gsum gyi dang po bdag bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis pad zla'i steng du bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes shing / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rang 'dra'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas bzhugs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i byang sems rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar babs pa las hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje/ de las mi bskyod pa'i skur gyur pa thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka ces pas thugs kha nas phyir phyung / phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ khyad par sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas/ rang la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi zla ba nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ rtsa zhal nag po khros pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'od dmar po 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

gnyis pa gnas bsrung ba ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po de las khro bo bcu dpag tu med pa spros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus khro bo bcu'i skur gyur nas/ rang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed/ lhor shes rab mthar byed/ nub tu rta mgrin/ byang du bgegs mthar byed/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rnams khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad dang ldan pas pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na g.yon brkyangs kyi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pas bskyed la zhal phyag sku mdog sogs lhag mos ltar bsam/ de nas/ 'og gi gnod mdzes las/ gnod mdzes gnyis pa byung / mdun du 'dug ste/ bdag gis ci bgyi zhes bka' nod par gyur/ oṃ sum+bha/ 'dul ba/ ni sum+bha hūm̐/ nges par 'dul ba/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa zungs zungs/ hūm̐/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya 'dzin du chug gnyis/ hūm̐/ a na ya ho/ khug cig bha ga wān/ bcom ldan 'das/ bi d+ya rā dza rig pa'i rgyal po/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje lcags kyur gyur nas bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying kha nas lcags kyus bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis sdigs bzhin pas bkug nas/ khro bo bcu la gtad pas phyi rol tu hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa'i nang du bcug par gyur/ byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i thugs kha nas/ rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam pa can/ smad mdung rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can me 'bar ba bcu spros te phyogs skyong bcu 'khor bcas kyi spyi bor zug par gyur/

oṃ gha gha/ gsod byed gnyis/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ choms shig gnyis/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ gdug pa can thams cad/ kī la ya kī la ya/ phur bus thob gnyis/ sarba pā paṃ sdig pa thams cad/phaṭ phaṭ dag pa dag pa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ rdo rje phur bu/ badz+ra dha ro adzñā pa ya ti rdo rje 'chang gis bka' bsgo bar byed do/ /sarba bigh+nān bgegs thams cad/ kā ya lus/ wak+ka ngag tsit+ta sems/ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ rdo rje phur bus thobs shig ces gnod mdzes la bka' bsgos pas gnod mdzes kyi lcags kyu de/ rdo rje tho ba me 'bar bar gyur nas/ phur bu'i spyi bo nas brdungs pas/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug ste/ sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi bar son par phur bus btab pas/ lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ yid rnam par rtog pa med par 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par gyur/ gnod mdzes gnyis pa 'og gi gnod mdzes la thim/ khro bo rnams dang phur bu las me 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bgegs kyi 'khor gdug pa can rnams 'tshig cing / phyogs bzhir bros/ me lce rnams slar bsdus phyi rol tu me'i ra bar gyur/ na maḥ phyag 'tshal lo/ sa man+ta kun nas dang bas/ kā ya sku/ wāk+ka gsung / tsit+ta thugs/ badz+ra ṇi/ rdo rje la/ ṭa ki 'dod pa/ hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod pas/ khro bo'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i ra ba dang / nang du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i gur dang / 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam mo/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor bsrung ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha so so la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan bcu gcig bzlas la/

sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod pa ste sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /snod bcud srung ba'i 'khor la dang bcas pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ye shes kyi sa bskyed pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su chos kyi 'byung gnas zur gsum pa/ kha dog dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ rlung g.yos me sbar zhing chu bskol te des sa bzhus nas/ thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa rdo rje'i sa bskyed pa'o/ /de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rin po che'i rtsig pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar ser dmar ljang / sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du rin po che bre phul gyi steng gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang / rnga yab dang / me tog gi 'phreng ba dang / me long dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu dang / steng du mda' yab pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyis bskor ba/

de dag gi bar snang rnams su rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zur rtse bzhir gdugs bzhis mdzes shing / phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu la gzungs ma sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang / zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i rin po che rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ phyi'i sa gzhi la/ rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis gang ba'o/ /de'i nang du lha snam rim pa gnyis shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i phyi nas 'od zer lngas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i phyi'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khang bzang dang shing thogs pa med pa/ phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu rtsa gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan gtso bo dang shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma ki la rdo rje/ de ma gtogs pa'i lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma'i gdan te/ thams cad kyang lha rdzas kyi rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ gsol thug mchod/

ces pas brten bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gsum/ lhag mos kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /dang po lhag mos ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rdo rje 'chang sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma sngon po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum reg rdo rje ma sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i sogs gong bzhin ral gri 'dzin pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ shar du rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon gong bzhin/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin pa g.yas dang pos thugs khar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la/ rin po che'i cod pan brog zhu la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /

dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa'o/ /shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo/ rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngon po rtsa ba dmar ba/ g.yon gong bzhin/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i ut+pal dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs khar ut+pal kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang gu don grub kyi cod pan can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje dang ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma ser mo rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis pi waṃ sngon po sgreng ba/ g.yas lhag mas 'khor lo dang ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon lhag ma gong bzhin/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo/ 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag ma gong bzhin/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang khu don grub kyi cod pan can/

ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis ro'i snod 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal/ g.yon lhag ma gong bzhin/ gtso bo'i mdun gyi reg rdo rje ste/ lha mo dgu po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg pa/ bzhin 'dzum zhing zur mig lta ba la sogs pas mdzes pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing / rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas brgyan pa 'dod yon lnga la rol ba'o/ /rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su byams pa/ g.yon du sa snying gnyis dkar po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi byams pa'i g.yas dang po klu shing gi me tog sdong po dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ sa snying gi g.yas dang po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'i g.yas lhag mas rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yas su phyag rdor/ g.yon du nam snying gnyis ser po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug sogs rin 'byung ltar bskyed/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon du 'jam dpal gnyis dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug sogs 'od dpag med ltar bskyed/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su sgrib sel/ g.yon du kun bzang gnyis ljang khu don grub kyi cod pan can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug sogs don grub ltar bskyed/ de thams cad kyang zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na dbyug pa/ 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa dang dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/

lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po/ ral gri/ g.yon snga ma dang 'dra ba/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na pad+ma ral gri/ gtun shing / g.yon dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas dkur brten pa dang / dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po don grub kyi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing / g.yon gshin rje'i gshed dang 'dra/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang / dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching ba/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon lhag mas zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs khar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa pad+ma dgra sta 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che sngon po don 'grub kyi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po/ rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ rtse gsum dgra sta 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor mdzad pa/

g.yas lhag mas rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon lhag mas sdigs mdzub dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ rin chen/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa pad+ma ral gri 'dzin pa/ khro bo thams cad kyang sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing / ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ gsus khyim che zhing 'phyang ba/ rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng na g.yon brkyangs kyi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ste/ lhag mos kyi rang bzhin bsgom pa'o/ /de nas/ lha so so'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkug dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugs te/ lha rnams kyi sku mthong bas sgrib pa dag byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyi dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i byin rlabs kyis rgyud rnam par dag nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob pas rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa lhag mos kyi mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i dang po rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis lha rnams gdan dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor 'khod pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ snying khar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ brla rtsar don yod grub pa/ lte bar spyan ma/ snying gar mā ma kī/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ spyi bor sgrol ma/ mig tu sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag rdor/

snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug snying khar 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje'i sgor sgrib sel/ tshigs mtshams rnams su kun bzang / spyi gtsug tu byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra rdo rje ma/ snar dri rdo rje ma/ lcer ro rdo rje ma/ rdo rje'i sgor reg rdo rje ma/ lag pa g.yas par gshin rje'i gshed/ g.yon pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ khar rta mgrin/ rdo rjer bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ dpung pa g.yas par mi g.yo ba/ g.yon par 'dod rgyal/ pus mo g.yas par dbyug sngon can/ g.yon par stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams rang gi phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams ngo bo dbyer med par gyur te/ rang gi lus de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab las grub pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'o/ /de nas/ lus kyi rnam snang / spyan ma/ gzugs rdo rje/ byams pa/ sa'i snying po/ gshin rje'i gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams 'od gsal du thim/ rin 'byung / mā ma kī/ phyag rdor/ sgra rdo rje/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ 'dod rgyal rnams 'od gsal du thim/ 'od dpag med/ gos dkar mo/ dri rdo rje/ nam snying / rta mgrin/ dbyug sngon can rnams 'od gsal du thim/ don grub/ sgrol ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang / bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams 'od gsal du thim/ steng 'og gi khro bo gnyis/ reg rdo rje dang bcas pa 'jam dpal la thim/ 'jam dpal gtso bo mi bskyod pa la thim/ de yang 'od gsal du thim zhes brjod cing bsam pa lhag mos don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o/ /oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal 'khor 'das de bzhin nyid du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsgom pa de bzhin nyid las byang chub pa'o/

/stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi nam mkhar hūm̐ sngon po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ yig 'bru gsum dang pad+ma yas mar thim/ nyi ma mas yar thim ste/ thams cad 'dus pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bur gyur/ de las 'od 'phros phyi nang snod bcud thams cad bsdus nas zla ba la thim pas/ rang gi 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ dharmā dha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa zla ba las byang chub pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa sa bon las byang chub pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ yig 'bru gsum la thim pas/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ badz+ra at+ma ko3haṃ zhes brjod cing bsam pa phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o/ /rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ dang po'i mgon po'i thugs kha nas mi bskyod pa spros/ des nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par byas/ sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang gi sdig sgrib pa sbyangs/ slar sku gcig tu gyur pa bdag nyid la rjes su zhugs pas bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/

g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni sprul skur bsgyur ba'o/ /de'i lus kyi mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon gnyis te bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ sna rtse bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ rlung lnga ni rtsig pa lnga/ lce'i rnam shes rin chen pha gu/ rgyu ma dra ba/ rgyus pa dra ba phyed pa/ byang sems dkar po zla phyed/ mig gi rnam shes me long / rna ba'i rnam shes ba dan/ sna'i rnam shes me tog gi 'phreng ba/ lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan/ mig rta babs kyi steng gi chos kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan ma/ yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags/ sna rta babs la gnas pa'i ba dan/ lce dril bu/ rna ba sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang / zur gyi rdo rje rin po che/ lus kyi tshogs rnams rnga yab la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ yid dbang dbus kyi pad+ma/ lto ba bum pa ste/ rdo rje 'chang gi lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ/ mgrin par 'du shes kyi ngo bo āḥ snying khar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐/ lte bar tshor ba'i ngo bo swā/ brla rtsar 'du byed kyi ngo bo hā/ lte bar sa khams kyi ngo bo laṃ/ snying khar chu khams kyi ngo bo māṃ/ mgrin par me khams kyi ngo bo pāṃ/ spyi bor rlung khams kyi ngo bo taṃ/ mig tu mig dbang gi ngo bo thiṃl/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ snar sna'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ lcer lce'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ snying khar yid dbang gi ngo bo hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sgor lus dbang gi ngo bo oṃ/ tshigs rnams su tshigs mtshams kyi ngo bo saṃ/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa rgyus kyi ngo bo mā+eṃ/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzaḥ rna bar sgra'i ngo bo hūm̐/ snar dri'i ngo bo baṃ/

lcer ro'i ngo bo hoḥ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ/ lag pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ khar kha'i ngo bo hūm̐/ rdo rjer rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐/ dpung pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ pus mo g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ spyi bor spyi bo'i ngo bo hūm̐/ rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ ste/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad lha'i ngo bor gyur/ ces brjod cing de rnams lha'i ngo bor bsam pa bsdus pa'i tshul gyis lus dkyil bsgom pa'o/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po ni/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las spyan ma'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rnam snang spyan ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su/ gtso bo sku rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed༞ deng bdag༞ rdo rje'i skus༞ zhes gtso 'khor thams cad la gsol ba btab pas/ rnam snang 'khor bcas bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas rang gi lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yis rab bskangs nas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ kā ya badz+ra sku rdo rje/ swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid can yin/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ba sogs sku byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /lcer pad+ma la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/

de las gos dkar mo'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas dang 'od dpag med gos dkar mo dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su/ gtso bo gsung rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed༞ deng bdag༞ rdo rje gsung༞ zhes gtso 'khor thams cad la gsol ba btab pas/ 'od dpag med 'khor bcas bdag gi mgrin pa nas zhugs pas/ rang gi ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing / /chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāk+kā badz+ra gsung rdo rje/ swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ba sogs gsung byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las mā ma kī'i tshogs spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mi bskyod pa mā ma kī dang snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang ba'i dbus su/ gtso bo thugs rdo rje mtshan dpes spras pa'i mdun du bdag nyid 'dug ste/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed༞ deng bdag༞ rdo rje thugs༞ zhes gtso 'khor thams cad la gsol ba btab pas mi bskyod pa 'khor bcas bdag gi snying kha nas zhugs pas/ rang gi sems thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin/

/gsang ba'i dbang po blo ldan pa/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra 'gyur zhing / /rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra thugs rdo rje/ swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ba sogs thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ste sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ gsung longs sku'i bdag nyid can yungs kar gyi tshad tsam/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du/ rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar thugs chos sku'i ngo bo ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ nag po 'od 'bar ba zhes brjod cing bsam/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rang 'dra'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa snyoms 'jug mdzad de/ bdud rtsi 'dzag pas/ sems dpa' gsum tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam pa ni sems pa gsum brtsegs bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes chags kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gi snying kha nas ye shes kyi phyag rgya phyung ste/ de khaṃ las rdo rje/ de las reg rdo rje ma sngon mo sogs/ zhal phyag rnams gong bzhin gsal btab/ de'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ zhes pa nas/ spyi bor rlung khaṃ gi ngo bo taṃ zhes pa'i bar dang / sa snying la sogs sems dpa' brgyad mi 'god par mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzāḥnas rdo rje'i tshab tu bha ga'i rtse mor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ lag pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/

zhes pa nas rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ ste de thams cad kyang lha'i ngo bor gyur/ ces pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod cing / 'on kyang khro bo bcu'i skabs su rdo rje zhes pa'i dus su bha gar bha ga'i ngo bo hūm̐ zhes brjod/ lha'i ngo bor bsam pa'i tshe/ lag pa g.yas la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su khro bo bcu'i tshab ro langs ma la sogs pa/ khro mo bcur bsgom pa ste phyag rgya 'du bya ba'o/ /rang gi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ rtse mor oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la rdo rje pad+ma 'du bya ba'o/ /yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer lngas gang bas rang rin 'byung du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms par bzhugs pas rang rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lus dkyil gyi lha thig ler zhu nas pad+mar babs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byang chub sems kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing bsgom/ cung zad mnyam par gzhag gsum pa las rgyal mchog la brgyad las/ dang po phra thig gi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gtso bor gsal ba'i rtsa zhal gyi sna rtser thig le la sems cung zad gtad pa'o/ /gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ yid kyis 'bru gsum ci nus su bzla'o/ /gsum pa ngag bzlas ni/ lha rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe sa bon las lha tshogs spros/ des 'gro ba'i don byas/ sngags dang lhan cig thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par bsam mo/ /bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de kho na nyid ci mang bzla/ kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka swā hūm̐/

oṃ āḥ.ā ro l+yika āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradzñā dhā+-i ka hā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmo hā ra ti laṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti maṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrā gā ra ti paṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti tāṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra dzaḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥshap+da badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ra baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥpar+ṣe badz+ra khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmai tri mai ཾhūm̐/ oṃ āḥk+ṣi ti gar+bha thalīṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkha gar+bha oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlo ki shwa ra oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmañdzu shrī hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsarba ṇi wa ra ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs man+ta bha dra saṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥya man+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradzñā na ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā tsa la hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmahā ba la hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams tshar gsum re/ ci nus su bzla/ bzlas tshar ba dang / bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ rang gi lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du aṃ las mchod yon ma dkar mo/ paṃ las me tog ma ser mo/ dhaṃ las bdug spos ma sngon mo/ daṃ las mar me ma dmar mo/ gaṃ las dri chab ma ljang khu/ naṃ las zhal zas ma dkar mo/ shaṃ las rol mo ma sngon mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis/ rang rang gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pa/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin la mdzes pa'i mdangs dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes dang dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas la se gol gtogs te/

rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros/ dpag tu med par gyur te dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' skor du 'khod nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes sogs mgor mgor gcig ma gtogs thams cad la mi sbyor/ sbyar ba'i nyer spyod dang / rdo rje ma lngas tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa phyi mchod/ nang gtor snod mi gsung bar 'og tu yaṃ las zhes pa gsung rgyun sta gon gyi snga dro nang mchod byin rlabs 'di dang 'og gi nang mchod skabs gnyis kar mdzad/ 'bru gsum tshar re dang bcas/ mchod gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rgyas par lha so so'i sngags sam/ bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swā zhes sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pa phul la rang gis kyang myang ba ste nang mchod/ rig ma dang snyoms par bzhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya bya ste gsang mchod bya'o/ /thal mo sbyar la/ gdangs mi mdzad par sgrigs 'don shur ma mdzad/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod pa'i mchod pa'o/

/nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis gzhal yas khang spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la thim pas/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas sa lha'i sgos mchod kyi mar me sbar la mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes sogs gong ltar las/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi zhes brjod cing tshom bu dgod par bsam/ tshom bu'i steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can/ phyag g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing / g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyi brgyan pa/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ lag pa g.yas sa la reg pas/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ rū pa sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim byin rlabs gong du grub pas/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da'i bar dang rol mo byed/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ gtor ma la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ /ces brjod/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa gsum gyis dbul/ spos dang bcas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ bcom dril gnang / skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyobs pa yi/

/ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas ste dkyil 'khor bri/ /lan gsum brjod la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces brjod cing gnang ba byin par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid du thim par gyur/ de nas lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang bsdams sa la bzhag la/ de las hūm̐ yig 'bar ba 'phros pas sa 'og gi bar rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa hūm̐/ lan gsum dang / oṃ badz+ra ḍi dha tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod pas brtan par bsam mo/ /de nas sa lha'i mchod gtor dang / tshom bu bsdus la/ lha so so'i tshom bu rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi ngag bzlas bzhin lan gsum re brjod pa tshom bu'i 'bod sngags so/ /de nas/ dngos po med la nas/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thim zhes pa'i bar brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su chos kyi 'byung gnas/ nas/ thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu rtsa gcig zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan gtso bo la nyi ma/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba zhes pa nas/ gdan dang bcas par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ de nas dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sogs/ shar du oṃ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sogs dang / lhor swā dang nor bu las rin 'byung /

sogs/ nub tu ā dang pad+ma las 'od dpag med/ sogs/ byang du ha dang ral gri las don yod grub pa/ sogs/ shar lhor laṃ dang ut+pal dkar po las spyan ma/ sogs/ lho nub tu maṃ dang ut+pal sngon po las mā ma kī sngon mo/ sogs/ nub byang du paṃ las ut+pal dmar po las gos dkar mo/ sogs/ byang shar du taṃ dang ut+pal ljang gu las sgrol ma/ sogs/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor dzaḥdang me long dmar po las gzugs rdo rje ma/ sogs/ lho nub tu hūm̐ dang pi wang sngon po las sgra rdo rje ma/ sogs/ nub byang du baṃ dang dri'i dung chos las dri rdo rje ma/ sogs/ byang shar du hoḥdang bcud kyi snod las ro rdo rje ma/ sogs/ gtso bo'i mdun du khaṃ dang rdo rje las reg rdo rje ma/ sogs gtso bo'i yum bzhin/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su maiṃ dang klu shing gi me tog sdong po dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa las byams pa/ g.yon du thiṃlā dang 'khor lo las sa snying / sogs/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yas su oṃ dang rin chen las phyag rdor/ g.yon du oṃ dang rin po che las nam snying gnyis/ sogs/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su oṃ dang pad+ma las 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon du hūm̐ dang pad+ma las 'jam dpal gnyis/ sogs/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su oṃ dang ral gri las sgrib sel/ g.yon du saṃ dang ral gri las kun bzang gnyis/ sogs/ shar sgor hūm̐ dang dbyug pa las gshin rje'i gshed/ sogs/ lho sgor hūm̐ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po las shes rab mthar byed/ sogs/ nub sgor hūm̐ dang pad+ma las rta mgrin/ sogs/ byang sgor hūm̐ dang sna tshogs rdo rje las bgegs mthar byed/ sogs/ shar lhor hūm̐ dang ral gri las mi g.yo ba/ sogs/ lho nub tu hūm̐ dang rdo rje las 'dod rgyal/ sogs/ nub byang du hūm̐ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po las dbyug sngon can/ sogs/ byang shar du hūm̐ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po las stobs po che/

sogs/ steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ sogs/ 'og tu hūm̐ dang rdo rje las gnod mdzes/ sogs/ sku mdog cod pan zhal phyag rgyan sogs lhag mos ltar brjod/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangasab ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ spos dang bcas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom dril gnang / ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad/ /mi zad dus kyi dpung gi phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ lha thams cad la rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyi dbang bskur nas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas sgos mchod rnams sbar la/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du aṃ las mchod yon ma dkar mo/ zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par gyur gyis bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / sa lha ltar mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'di/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ oṃ dzi na dzig ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ man chad thams cad la sbyar ba'i/ oṃ swā rat+ma dhṛka༞ oṃ āḥ.a ro lika༞ oṃ hā prañdza dhṛka༞ oṃ laṃ mo ha rā ti༞

oṃ maṃ dwe ṣa ra ti༞ oṃ paṃ rā ga ra ti༞ oṃ taṃ badz+ra ra ti༞ oṃ raṃ rū pa badz+ri༞ oṃ shaṃ shap+da badz+ri༞ oṃ gaṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri༞ oṃ raṃ ra sa badz+ri༞ oṃ khaṃ par+ṣe badz+ri༞ oṃ maiṃ me tri༞ oṃ thalīṃ k+ṣi ta gar+bha༞ oṃ oṃ badz+ra pa ṇi༞ oṃ oṃ kha gar+bha༞ oṃ oṃ lo ke shwa ra༞ oṃ hūm̐ mañdzu shrī༞ oṃ oṃ sarba ṇi wa ra ṇa bi skaṃ bhi ni༞ oṃ saṃ sa man+ta bha dra༞ oṃ hūm̐ ya man+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ pradzñān+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ p+man+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ bigh+nān+ta kṛta༞ oṃ hūm̐ ā tsa la༞ oṃ hūm̐ ṭak+ki rā dza༞ oṃ hūm̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa༞ oṃ hūm̐ mahā ba la༞ oṃ hūm̐ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti༞ oṃ hūm̐ sum+bha rā dza ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyed kyis bzhes/ /oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas sum+bha rā dza'i bar/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su puṣ+paṃ bcug pa gong bzhin dang / lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu༞ ci bde bar ni༞ puṣ+paṃ gyi gnas su dhu paṃ bcug la lha sngags tshang mas gong bzhin dbul/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /dhu paṃ gyi gnas su/ dī paṃ sogs bzhin/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu༞ ci bde bar ni༞ dī paṃ gyi gnas su gan+dhaṃ sogs gong bzhin/ bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing / /thams cad sbyar ba'i zhal zas 'di/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /ghan+dhaṃ gyi gnas su nai wi d+yaṃ sogs gong bzhin/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu༞ ci bde bar ni༞ nai wi d+yaṃ gi gnas su shap+da sogs gong bzhin lha sngags tshang mas phul/

dharmā ra ṇi dang rol chen bya/ de nas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ phyag rgya spyi dang mthun/ rin chen dbang gi rgyal po bai ḍūr+ya/ /sngon po la sogs kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs/ /rnam gsum gzugs kyi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi spyan la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ ma zin 'byung ba'i tshogs pa las byung ba'i/ /brjod bral dbyangs la sogs pa sgra yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum sgra yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi snyan la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥshap+da badz+ri hūm̐ dang rol chen/ ga pur a kar dza ti la sogs pa/ /legs par sbyar ba'i byug pa dri yi tshogs/ /rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi shangs la dbul bar gyi/ /oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+ri hūm̐/ lus mchog brtas byed bdud rtsi'i zas la sogs/ /mngar skyur kha dang bska la sogs pa'i ro/ /rnam gsum ro yi rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi ljags la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥr sa badz+ri hūm̐/ lus la reg pa tsam gyis bde ster ba/ /dpag bsam gos la sogs pa reg bya'i tshogs/ /rnam gsum reg bya'i rdo rje mar byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi lus la dbul bar bgyi/ /oṃ āḥpar+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐ dang gos zung phul/ de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pa yongs grags dang / nye ba'i rin chen bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang / /yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' mgu rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /'dir gdangs 'deg gang 'dod lta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyi/ /thags bzang bsregs bcad mi nus 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi 'bying ngal dub med pa'i lham/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'dir gdangs 'deg 'di dag gis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa/

/bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ sap+ta u pa rat+na pū ts+tshi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'o/ /nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar byas la 'bru gsum tshar gcig nang mchod nas mtheb srin g.yon pas blangs nang mchod byin rlabs kyang gnang / ste gtor bas rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas mchod par bsam zhing / ngag gtor gnod kyi 'og tu mi gsung bar 'og tu yaṃ las zhes pa gsung rgyun yin/ tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gnyis/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gang la thob pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa yin no/ /de nas/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ klu las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen/ grub chen klu'i byang chub/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa/ sa 'dres pa chen po/ paṇa chen bir+ya bha dra/ de wā a ka ra tsan+d+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ 'gos lo tsā ba/ dbus pa dge ser/ bla ma gnam kha 'ub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ gnam kha 'ub pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/

bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyas par na lha sngags tshang ma'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'am bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swā aḥhā/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ mai thiṃlā/ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ saṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa bsdus pa 'di don tshang bas legs so/ /gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas lus dkyil lha tshims par bsam/ bar phud kyi gtor ma rnams sbyangs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā li de bī ye/ dharmā pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri bā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam bral/ gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ gza' chen dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dgas/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang mchod ni/ rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khyud rgya byas pa'i rkyen gyis lha tshogs thams cad snyoms par bzhugs pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas thugs rgyud tshim par bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs sgrub thabs ltar de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bzlas pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spros/ mdun gyi lha rnams la phog pas de dag gi thugs bde bas mnyes par byas/ 'od zer rnams kyi rtse mo nas mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ des phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ ā badz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ nas/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ gi bar sgrub thabs kyi ngag bzlas bzhin lan gsum re bzlas pas lha rnams mnyes par bsam/

de nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing 'dod don la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /de nas bum bskyed ni gong du bshams pa'i bum pa gnyis kyi rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos rdo rje gzungs thag 'jog pa la sogs phyag len ltar bcas pa la/ sarba bigh+nan gyis bsangs/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan gtso bo la nyi ma/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje/ de ma gtogs pa'i lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma'i gdan/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sogs gtso bo nas/ gnod mdzes sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ g.yon thugs khar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ pad+ma ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang / las thams cad pa'i bum par hūm̐ las bgegs mthar byed sngon po don grub kyi cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa dang / dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/

khro bo thams cad sma ra dang / sogs lha sta gon bzhin tshang bar bskyed/ 'on kyang rdo rje'i cho ga gsum bskyed mi dgos sa bon tsam las bskyed do/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis khro bo bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rū pa sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la bstim pa nas gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / rang gi rigs bdag gi dbang bskur ba sogs lha sta gon bzhin byas la/ re re'i mgor mtshan sngags tshogs zhing ltar/ gong bzhin sbyar ba'i mchod yon nas rol chen gyi bar sngags tsam gyi phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ swā/ sogs sa bon gyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod/ rdo dril 'dzin pas de nyid lnga pas bstod la/ de nas pad bskor dang bcas pas gzungs thag blangs te/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ lha thams cad kyi rgyud bskul te sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod la rnam rgyal la gtso bo'i sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig gzhan rnams ngag bzlas bzhin gsum re dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dang / oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐ zhes dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rnams nyer gcig re bzlas la gong bzhin mchod bstod dang / dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes dang / hūm̐ zhes bsngags pa bum pa gnyis su blugs te/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod las bum gyi chu nas ku shas bum pa la gtor te/ na mo badz+ra kro dha ya/ mahā daṃṣ+ṭ+wa to ka ṭa bhai ra wa ya a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pa hāstā ya oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hū lu hū lu/

tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi na ya ka nān mahā ga na pa ti/ dzi we te/ an+d+ra ka rā ya swāhā/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / bar snang gi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsams la/ nub gnyis pa man chad la mchod pa 'di mi dgos/ phyi nang bstod pa'i mchod pa bum bskyed ltar byas nas/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsam ste ngag tu/ thugs rje bcom dril gnang / yis ni bdag cag bdag /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse dang / /khyed cag la yang mchod slad du/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan gus pas bdag la ni/ /de phyir bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag gis/ /gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor mdzes pa ni/ /cho ga ci nus yo byad kyis/ /sang ni yang dag bri bar 'gyur/ /de phyir slob mar bcas bdag la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung ste/ /'khor bcas kun gyis dkyil 'khor la/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad par 'os/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces brjod cing gnang ba byin par bsam/ de nas gtor ma phul ba ni/ gtor ma rnams/ bigh+nān gyis bsangs/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ pad+ma dmar po ās mtshan pa'i shar du gau las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu ra las rak+ta/ nub byang du shu las byang sems/

byang shar du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ de thams cad la oṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng gi bar snang la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas rdzas rnams bzhu zhing bskol te 'bar bar gyur/ steng gi zla ba rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung nas dkrugs shing / de nyid 'dres pas ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ pad+ma ā dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros dri ma med par byas nas nyi ma'i mdog can gyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rtogs/ oṃ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kha nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas 'og gi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med par spel zhing sbar bar gyur/ kyai rdor bde mchog sogs la'ang gtor ma byin rlabs logs su mi mdzad pa ha ho hri nas mdzad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur pa'i ra dbus ma la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ nas/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar lha sngags tshang ma lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod yon dang rol mo bzhag pa'i nyer spyod lnga dang / bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bum bskyed bzhin gyis mchod la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes pa'i bar yongs grags kyi bden pa'i stobs brjod/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/

/ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar yongs grags kyi 'phrin las bcol/ de nas kye rdor sogs yi dam gyi lha dang / sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la rang rang gi phyag len bzhin gyi gtor ma 'bul/ de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor phul la 'jig rten pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ gtor snod kyi shar du skad cig gis dbang po ser skya glang po che la gnas pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la gnas pa g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas zhags pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa g.yas bi dza pū ra ga dang / g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ mer me lha dmar po ra skyes la gnas pa g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ bden bral du srin po nag po ro langs la gnas pa g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rlung du rlung lha dud kha ri dwags la gnas pa phyag gnyis kyis rlung ras 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la gnas pa g.yas rtse gsum dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la gnas pa zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor du lha klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri bza'/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding / mi'am ci/ lto 'phye chen po/ 'byung po/ yi dgas/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ rnon po la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/

de rnams skad cig gis stong pa nyid du gyur pa las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur/ gtor mgron rnams kyis gong bzhin du gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ da sha dika a ba s+d+yi te bh+yaḥsogs sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin lan gsum gyis dbul/ de nas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pa la sa pā ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ phyogs bcur rnam par gnas rnams dang / /zhes sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod nas 'phrin las bcol la gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs 'bul ba rnams phyag len rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas dbul/ slob ma sta gon dgos na sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor bzhin bya/ de nas rjes chog ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs byin brlabs byas te bum bskyed ltar phyi mchod/ rū pa sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ nang mchod kyi mjug tu/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa sogs sta gon bzhin mdzad/ gsang mchod kyang sta gon bzhin dang / de nyid lnga pas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel mdzub mo brkyangs te rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya bzlog ste spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas te/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/

med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥrten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thob gyur cig /'gro bas kyang ni de thob shog /byang chub phyir ni spyod gang dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gang yin dang / /byang chub rdo rjes gang gsungs pa'i/ /spyod de gnyis ka'ang bdag spyod shog /ces pas bsngo ba bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi bkra shis byas la sta gon gyi mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdu'o// ༈ //de nas thig tshon byin rlabs lhan cig byar rung bas/ slob dpon gyi mdun du ras la sogs pa'i steng du dbus su thig tshon sngon po/ shar du dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang gu rnams bkod/ rdo rje'i rtses tshon gyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i rigs lnga'i sa bon bri/ chu gcig sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bshams/ slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thig tshon rnams bigh+nan gyis bsangs/ shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma sngon po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ thig tshon dkar po oṃ las rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon gong bzhin/ thig tshon ser po swā las rin 'byung ser po/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas na nor bu/ rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu/ pad ser/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dmar po ā las 'od dpag med dmar po/

dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs khar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag ma rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ljang gu hā las don grub ljang khu/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri dang / sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu/ pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog byas pa la rin po che'i cod pan prog zhu la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal dang / dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs khar hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thig tshon lnga 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣoḥbh+yaḥbadz+ra su traṃ me pra yats+tsha mahā maṇ+ḍa la sū tra na ya hūm̐/ zhes mi bskyod pa la gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du gong 'og rnams 'dra ba las/ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥyi gnas su/ sha shwa tas rnam snang / rat+na sam+bha was rin 'byung / a mi ta bha was 'od dpag med/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha sid+dhi badz+ra sū traṃ me pra yats+tsha mahā maṇ+ḍa la sū tra ṇa ya hūm̐/ zhes pas don grub la gsol ba btab/ rang mi bskyod par gsal ba'i mig gnyis su dzaḥlas nyi ma dang zla ba ser po'i steng du/ oṃ dip+ta diṣ+ṭi aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pas mtshan pa zhes brjod/ oṃ dip+ta sogs gong 'og gi sngags lan gsum brjod cing / mig gi rdzi ma brdabs shing 'gugs pa'i lta stangs bya/ nam mkha'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs kha nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas mdun gyi thig tshon gyi rigs lnga la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags rnams nyi shu rtsa re bzlas/

de nas/ pañtsa ku la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dril bu gsil zhing / mi bskyod rdo rjes bstod la/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul tshon mang zhing sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can la chags pa dang / rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig ces dang / rigs lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ ces brjod de/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis yi ge rnams bsub/ oṃ ā n+yo n+yā a nu ga ta sarba dharmā s+pha ra s+pha ra/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā a d+yan+ta/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭa/ sarba dharmā oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing thig skud kyi sne slob ma la gtad la/ des kyang dang po so so dang / de nas phyogs sgril nas rdo rjer dkris/ dri bzang gi chu gtor la/ puṣ+pe la sogs pa lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭ ces brjod cing blang ngo / /de nas slob dpon langs te dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal dang / slob ma shar du rnam snang gi nga rgyal 'dzin pa dpon slob gnyis kas rdor dril thogs la slob dpon gyis nam mkha'i lha nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ mig byin rlabs dran pas/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing slob ma rnam snang la gtad/ slob mas kyang / dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing blangs la lte ba'i thad du bzung ste/ nub nas shar du brkyang / slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pas lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang gung mos thig skud bzung la/ dang por steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab cing se gol gyi sgra bya/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra/ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā/ sems can don du khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon thig skud la thim par bsam/

de nas sa la phab ste thig chen brgyad po dang / logs thig bzhi steng du btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam/ de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la gdab bo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni gong du bstan pa bzhin tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de nas g.yas skor gyis slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros kyis phyin la lho dang / de bzhin du slob mas rgyab 'gros kyis phyin la byang du bsdad pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ de nas bla ma mer bsdad la slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma srin por gnas pas lho'i thig gdab/ slob ma de nyid dang slob dpon rlung du phyin nas nub kyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du phyin nas byang gi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon slob ma la g.yas skor gyis mer phyin/ de bzhin du slob mas slob dpon la bskor te rlung du phyin nas zur thig dang po gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma la g.yas skor gyis srin por phyin/ slob mas slob dpon la bskor te dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab/ de nas slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas pas thig skud bsdus la slob ma la gtad/ 'di'i sdom ni/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /dang po slob dpon phyis slob ma/ /slob dpon me la slob ma srin/ /slob ma srin la slob dpon rlung / /slob dpon rlung la slob ma dbang / /slob dpon me la slob ma rlung / /slob dpon srin la slob ma dbang / /slob dpon nub dang slob ma ni/ /shar du gnas pas thig bsdu 'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor phyin la/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥzhes brjod la ye thig nam mkhar bteg ste dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin la gzhi bca' pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu dkur brten te/
