rang gi mig g.yas g.yon haṃ las nyi ma dang zla bar bsams la/ hīḥhīḥzhes brjod cing phyogs kun tu khro bo'i blta bas/ sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas skor du bltas pas/ sgor 'jug pa'i sgrib pa bsal te sgo rnams dbye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams srin lag gnyis kyi dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbyi bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shar du phyogs pas 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bris shing / ngag tu/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rang grol mdzad/ /rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐ḥzhes brjod cing nang nas rim pa bzhin sngon po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams rim pas sgo tshad gcig rnams bris la ting la sogs pas kha bcad nas steng du ye thig gi rdo rje tshon skud dkris pa bzhag las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung / nyer spyod lngas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rjes bstod la/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas/ dkar po la sogs pas rim pas bkang / de nas rang ngam slob mas ci bder bris te dbus kyi re mig sngon po/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / 'dod yon dmar po la lha mo bcu drug gi mtshan ma me tog tshon spungs/ pha gu ser po la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa/ dra phyed kyi gzhi nag po la mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pas brgyan pa/ de dag gi nang du zla phyed rdo rje dang / rin po ches spras pa shar bu dang / mda' yab kyi gzhi sngon po la shar bu dkar po dang / mda' yab pad 'dab phyed pa'i dbyibs can bris pa'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis mdzes par byas la/

rta babs kyi ka ba dang / kyog po'i nang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra rnams phyogs mdog rta babs kyi snam bu'i shar bu dang mda' yab sngar dang 'dra/ mun snam sngon po/ rin chen ser po/ rta rmig dang / ba ran+d+ra ni mdzes tshon/ ser snam ni ser po/ mda' yab kyi snam bu'i dbus su pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags ser po/ de'i phyi rol tu spre'us bzung ba'i gdugs re re/ pad+ma'i lte ba ljang gu ni khyams ljang / 'dab ma sna tshogs pad ra/ ge sar ser po ze 'bru/ pad+ma'i sa gzhi 'di'i ze'u 'bru'i mtha'i srub seng byung na dmar skyas 'gengs pa e yin snyam mo/ /chos 'byung gi re kha dkar po/ rdo rje ra ba'i gzhi ser po la rdo rje nag po/ de'i 'khor yug gi re kha dkar po/ 'od zer 'phreng ba kha dog lnga dang ldan pa bri'o/ /de'i nang du ling tshe dgu pa'i phyi rol 'od zer 'phreng ba kha dog lnga pa/ de'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i 'phreng ba gzhi sngon po la rdo rje dkar po/ ka 'di bsgom don/ ba rnams gzhi sngo nag la shar gyi ka ba la 'khor lo/ lho la rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri rnams phyogs mdog tu bri zhing rtsig pa sbrel ran dus su/ ting dang rdo rje bsal la mtshan ma bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na nam mkha'i lha la mchod gtor phul te 'khyil pas bsrung ngo / /rdul tshon gyi dbus su mtshan ma dgod pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du gtso bo dang shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje sngon po 'phred la bstan pa/ lho phyogs pa gzhan rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po/

byang du ral gri ljang gu/ shar lhor dbus nag la mtha' dkar ba'i spyan/ lho nub tu rdo rje sngon po 'grengs bu langs pa nub byang du pad+ma dmar po kha bye ba sdong bu dang bcas pa/ byang shar du ut+pal sngon po yu ba can/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor me long dmar po/ lho nub tu pi wang sngon po/ nub byang du dung chos ser po/ byang shar du zhal zas kyi snod dmar po/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa la 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa dang / g.yon du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che gnyis/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po gnyis/ byang du ral gri ljang khu gnyis/ shar sgor tho ba sngon po/ lho sgor rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po/ nub sgor pad+ma dmar po/ byang sgor sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar lhor ral gri/ lho nub tu zhags pa/ nub byang dang byang shar du ral gri re re/ shar sgo'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi steng du gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i gzugs/ nub sgo'i rta mgrin gyi steng du zhags pa rnams kha dog nag por bri/ mtshan ma thams cad 'od zer lngas bskor ba rang rang gi phyogs su mgo bstan pa/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma ni nub tu mgo phyogs par bya'o/ /bri ba rdzogs pa dang / tshon gyi lhag dang ye thig gi srad bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus la gong bzhin/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rjes bstod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥthig tshon gyi ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs ste dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams la spos dang rol mo dang bcas te slob dpon lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang lhan cig pas rnam rgyal bum pa dang / slob mas las bum bzung yi ge brgya pa rjod bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lha so so'i sngags brjod cing de dang de'i gnas su 'bul tshul tsam re byas la rang gi mgo ru gtugs/

bdag dang sems can thams cad la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod de rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bzhag de nas las bum slob dpon gyis thogs la/ oṃ bigh+nīn+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod cing bgegs mthar byed la 'bul tshul dang / khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad las bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod de dbang ldan phyogs su bzhag go/ ༈ //spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar spyi mchod sta gon ltar dang sgos mchod ji tsam 'byor pa ci mdzes su bkod/ sta gon bzhin yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma sogs logs su bshams/ gzhan yang slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo dril nang mchod bum pa gos zung / dbu rgyan sogs bdag 'jug gi chas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ phyi rol pa'i gtor ma/ de'i lha bshos ting lo sogs dang slob ma dbang bskur byed na de la dgos pa'i dbang rdzas dang mchod pa sogs nyer mkho thams cad phyag len bzhin ma tshang ba med par bshams la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsam ste rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstims grub 'phral/ de nas/ rang skad cig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus par gyur/ ces brjod nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ mchod pa 'di kho na la ma gtogs shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i ā 'di mchod pa gzhan la med do/ /de bzhin du pūṣ+pe nas/ shap+da'i bar dang / rdo rje ma lnga'i sngags rgya tsam gyis mchod de/ rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor du zhugs par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las dpal gsang ba 'dus par gsal ba'i snying khar pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/

'og min nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i zhes sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gong gi sta gon gyi skabs kyi las rgyal mchog ltar byas la/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'i tshe/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad spyan drangs te/ rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor 'khod pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ ces sogs dang sbrel lo/ /dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dir pu dza badz+ra sogs kyi rjes su mnyam bzhag mi mdzad par/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo spyan drangs/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs te zhu ba dang / rang yab yum gyi lus kyi lha rnams thig le'i rnam par zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa las thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ thun mong gi gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sum cu rtsa gcig thun mong ma yin pa'i gdan dbus su nyi ma/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba zhes pa nas/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma'i gdan zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ thig le cha gcig cha so gnyis su gyur nas/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa las lha rnams su gyur pa ni dbus kyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ de las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal phyag rdo rje 'chang bzhin bsam/ de bzhin du/ shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ ces pa thams cad la rigs 'gre/ de las 'khor lo/ de las rnam par snang mdzad/ lho'i thig le oṃ āḥswā hūm̐ du gyur/ de las nor bu/ de las rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.āḥhūm̐ du gyur/

de las pad+ma/ de las 'od dpag med/ byang gi thig le oṃ āḥtaṃ hā hūm̐/ de las ral gri/ de las don yod grub pa/ shar lho'i thig le oṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las ut+pal dkar po/ de las spyan ma/ lho nub kyi thig le oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ de las ut+pal sngon po/ de las mā ma kī/ nub byang gi thig le oṃ āḥpaṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las ut+pal dmar po/ de las gos dkar mo/ byang shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las ut+pal ljang khu/ de las sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i thig le oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las me long dmar po/ de las gzugs rdo rje ma/ lho nub kyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las pi wang sngon po/ de la sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang gi thig le oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las dri'i dung chos/ de las dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥhoḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las bcud kyi snod/ de las ro rdo rje ma/ gtso bo'i mdun gyi thig le oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje/ de las reg rdo rje ma/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥmā+ai ཾhūm̐ du gyur/ de las klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa/ de las byams pa/ g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥ thalīṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'khor lo/ de las sa'i snying po lha'i snam bu'i g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rin po che/ de las phyag rdor/ g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rin po che/ de las nam mkha'i snying po/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las pad+ma/ de las 'jig rten dbang phyug g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las pad+ma/ de las 'jam dpal/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas kyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las ral gri/

de las sgrib sel/ g.yon gyi thig le oṃ āḥsaṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las ral gri/ de las kun bzang / shar sgo'i thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las dbyug pa/ de las gshin rje'i gshed/ de bzhin du sa bon dang / yig 'bru gsum spel ba khro bo thams cad 'dra bar sbyar la/ lho sgo'i thig le༞ de las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po/ de las shes rab mthar byed/ nub sgo'i thig le༞ de las pad+ma dmar po/ de las pad+ma mthar byed/ byang sgo'i thig le/ sogs/ de las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las bgegs mthar byed/ shar lho'i thig le/ sogs/ de las ral gri/ de las mi g.yo ba/ lho nub kyi thig le/ sogs/ de las rdo rje/ de las 'dod rgyal/ nub byang gi thig le/ sogs/ de las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po/ de las dbyug sngon can/ byang shar gyi thig le/ sogs/ de las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po/ de las stobs po che/ steng gi thig le/ sogs/ de las rdo rje/ de las gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ 'og gi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje/ de las gnod mdzes rgyal po rnams su gyur/ ces brjod cing / zhal phyag sngar bzhin lhag mos kyi skabs ltar bsam ste/ mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /spro ba'i tshe/ mkha' nang gi mi bskyod pa rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs kha nas mi bskyod pa'i tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas spyi'i mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs te/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ rang nyid la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi zla ba nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhi ba/ de zhe sdang rdo rjer gyur pa/ sku mdog mthing nag khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ rtsa zhal nag po khros pa/

g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin zhing rtsa phyag gnyis kyis reg rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog tu byas pa la rin po che'i cod pan prog zhu la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas ga shal dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi rnam snang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ dzi na dzika thugs kha nas rnam snang gi tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs sangs rgyas spyi'i mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par gti mug can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ rnam snang gi go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ re mig shar gyi pad zla'i steng du mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum zhes sogs kyis gsal gdab/ mkha' nang gi rin 'byung rang gi thugs kar drangs/ rat+na dhṛka thugs kha nas rin 'byung gi tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas spyi'i mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par nga rgyal dang ser sna can rnams kyi nyon mongs sbyangs/ rin 'byung gi go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ re mig lho'i pad+ma dang rin po che'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi 'od dpag med rang gi thugs kar drangs/ ā ro lika thugs kha nas 'od dpag med kyi tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs 'dra/ khyad par 'dod chags can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyangs/ 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/

re mig nub kyi pad+ma dmar po'i gdan mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i sogs/ mkha' nang gi don grub rang gi thugs kar drangs/ pradzñā dhṛka thugs kha nas don grub kyi tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs 'dra/ khyad par rdzun du smra ba dang phrag dog can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa sbyangs/ don grub kyi go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ re mig byang gi sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las don grub ljang khu mi bskyod pa'i sogs 'dra/ mkha' nang gi spyan ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ mo ha ra ti/ thugs kha nas spyan ma spros/ sems can nad gdon gyis gdungs pa rnams zhi bar mdzad/ sprul pa rnams gcig 'dus/ shar lhor zla gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi mā ma kī rang gi thugs kar drangs/ dwe ṣa ra ti/ thugs kha nas mā ma kī spros/ sems can bgegs chen pos gzir ba rnams thugs rje chen pos bsrungs te rgyas par mdzad/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ lho nub tu rdo rje'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ mā ma kī sngon po mi bskyod pa'i sogs/ mkha' nang gi gos dkar mo rang gi thugs kar drangs/ rā ga ra ti/ thugs kha nas gos dkar mo spros/ sems can gdon gyis nyen pa rnams zhi bar mdzad/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ nub byang du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gos dkar mo 'od dpag med kyi sogs/ mkha' nang gi sgrol ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra ra ti/ thugs kha nas sgrol ma spros/ sems can thams cad dbang du mdzad/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ byang shar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sgrol ma ljang khu don grub kyi sogs/

mkha' nang gi gzugs rdo rje ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ rū pa badz+ra/ thugs kha nas gzugs rdo rje ma spros/ yul gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs/ rgyal ba rnams gzugs sdug pa'i bde bas mchod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i grwar zla gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi sgra rdo rje ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ shap+da badz+ra/ thugs kha nas sgra rdo rje ma spros/ sgra'i skye mched sbyangs/ sgra snyan pa'i bde bas mchod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ lho nub kyi grwar rin po che'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma ser mo rin 'byung gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi dri rdo rje ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ gan+dhe badz+ra/ thugs kha nas dri rdo rje ma spros/ dri'i skye mched sbyangs/ dri'i bde bas mchod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ nub byang gi grwar pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi sogs/ mkha' nang gi ro rdo rje ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ ra sa badz+ra/ thugs kha nas ro rdo rje ma spros/ ro'i skye mched sbyangs/ ro'i brtas pa'i bde bas mchod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ byang shar gyi grwar sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ ro rdo rje ma ljang khu don grub kyi sogs/ mkha' nang gi reg rdo rje ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ par+ṣe badz+ra/ thugs kha nas reg rdo rje ma spros/ reg bya'i skye mched sbyangs/ reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ gtso bo'i mdun gyi nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ reg rdo rje ma sngon po sogs/ mkha' nang gi byams pa rang gi thugs kar drangs/ mai tri/ thugs kha nas byams pa spros/ rtsa rgyus dang nyon yid sbyangs/

rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag zad kyi mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar gyi snam bu'i g.yas su zla gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las byams pa/ mkha' nang gi sa snying rang gi thugs kar drangs/ k+ṣi ti gar+bha/ thugs kha nas sa snying spros/ mig dang mig shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i mig dang lha'i mig gi mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ shar gyi snam bu'i g.yon du zla gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sa snying gnyis dkar po rnam snang gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi phyag rdor rang gi thugs khar drangs/ badz+ra pa ṇi/ thugs kha nas phyag rdor spros/ rna ba dang rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rna ba dang lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yas su rin po che'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las phyag rdor sogs/ mkha' nang gi nam snying rang gi thugs khar drangs/ kha gar+bha/ thugs kha nas nam snying spros/ sna dang rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i sna dang sna'i mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ lho'i snam bu'i g.yon du rin po che'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ nam snying gnyis ser po rin 'byung gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi 'jig rten dbang phyug rang gi thugs khar drangs/ lo ke shwa ra/ thugs kha nas 'jig rten dbang phyug spros/ lce dang lce shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lce dang lce'i mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yas su pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug mkha' nang gi 'jam dpal rang gi thugs khar drangs/ mañdzu shrī/ thugs kha nas 'jam dpal spros/ yid dang ye shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i yid dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ nub kyi snam bu'i g.yon du pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/

'jam dpal gnyis dmar po 'od dpag med kyi sogs/ mkha' nang gi sgrib sel rang gi thugs khar drangs/ sarba ṇi wa ra ṇa biskaṃ bhi ni/ thugs kha nas sgrib sel spros/ lus dang lus shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i lus dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las sgrib sel/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi kun bzang rang gi thugs khar drangs/ sa man+ta bha dra/ thugs kha nas kun bzang spros/ tshigs dang kun gzhi sbyangs/ rdo rje'i tshigs dang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ byang gi snam bu'i g.yon du sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ kun bzang gnyis ljang khu don grub kyi/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi gshin rje gshed rang gi thugs khar drangs/ ya man+ta krita/ thugs kha nas gshin rje'i gshed spros/ dbang po la sogs pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams skrag par mdzad/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ shar sgor nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi shes rab mthar byed rang gi thugs khar drangs/ prādzñā ta krita/ thugs kha nas shes rab mthar byed spros/ gshin rje dang ma mo la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ lho sgor nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi rta mgrin rang gi thugs kar drangs/ pad+ma krita/ thugs kha nas rta mgrin spros/ klu dang sa bdag gi gdon bgegs thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ nub sgor nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang / ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi/

sogs/ mkha' nang gi bgegs mthar byed rang gi thugs kar drangs/ bigh+nān+ta krita/ thugs kha nas bgegs mthar byed spros/ gnod sbyin dang log 'dren la sogs pa'i bgegs thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ byang sgor nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bgegs mthar byed sngon po don grub kyi/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi mi g.yo ba rang gi thugs khar drangs/ ā tsā la/ thugs kha nas mi g.yo ba spros/ yams nad gtong ba'i me lha'i gdon thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ shar lhor nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi 'dod rgyal rang gi thugs khar drangs/ ṭak+ki ra dza/ thugs kha nas 'dod rgyal spros/ bden bral gyi bgegs thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ lho nub tu nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi sogs/ mkha' nang gi dbyug sngon can rang gi thugs khar drangs/ nī la daṇ+ḍa/ thugs kha nas dbyug sngon can spros/ yams nad rlung lha'i gdon thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ nub byang du nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi stobs po che rang gi thugs khar drangs/ mahā ba la/ thugs kha nas stobs po che spros/ mkha' 'gro dbang ldan gyi gdon thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ byang shar du mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba rang gi thugs khar drangs/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ thugs kha nas gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba spros/ tshangs pa dang lha'i gdon thams cad bcom/

yang dag pa'i lam la 'god/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ gtso bo'i steng gi nam mkhar nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i/ sogs/ mkha' nang gi gnod mdzes rang gi thugs khar drangs/ sum+bha ra dza/ thugs kha nas gnod mdzes spros/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug kā la ku ṭa la sogs pa klu dang sa bdag gi gdon thams cad bcom/ yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ gtso bo'i 'og tu nyi gdan la mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las gnod mdzes sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sogs nas/ g.yon brkyangs kyi stabs kyis me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar zhal phyag rnams lhag mos ltar brjod cing gsal btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang spros/ snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma sbyangs/ rang bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang dang 'dres/ slar sngar gyi gzhal yas khang la thim pas gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de ltar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang / chu nang gi zla ba ltar stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ 'dir mnyam gzhag mi mdzad par slar yang yab yum sogs la zhes brjod cing bsgom/ de nas ye shes mngal 'byin bya ba ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dbyung ba sogs mi dgos par/ slar yang yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pas phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs te/ zhu ba'i rkyen gyis lus kyi lha rnams kyang thig ler zhu nas/ yum gyi pad+ma'i dbus su babs pas thig le cha so gnyis su gyur pa'i dbus kyi thig le oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ shar gyi thig le oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'khor lo/ de las rnam par snang mdzad/

ces pa nas gnod mdzes bskyed pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog bzhin byas la/ de nas/ mkha' nang gi mi bskyod pa rang gi thugs khar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs kha nas mi bskyod pa'i tshogs nam mkha' khyab par spros/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa sangs rgyas spyi'i mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus te mi bskyod pa'i zhing du gshegs/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du gnod mdzes kyi bar du rigs sgres te/ gnod mdzes rang gi zhing du gshegs/ de rnams rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing na bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmachog tu dga' ba'i sku dang ldan pas slar yang 'byon par bzhed bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs khar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' re re/ de rnams kyi thugs khar zla ba'i gdan la so so'i phyag mtshan gyi lte bar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ oṃ swā āḥhā laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ zhes pa nas hūm̐ bcu'i bar brjod la/ rang dam tshig sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi ye shes pa rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ 'og gi gnod mdzes las gnod mdzes gnyis pa bdag gi mdun du 'ongs nas bka' nod pa las de bzhin gshegs pa rnams slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i phyir 'byon par skul cig ces bsgoms pas des de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūm̐ zhes sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad/ /mi zad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/

/sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /lan gsum rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ dngos gzhi dang po'i nyin nam mkhar bteg pa'i sta gon gyi lha la rdo rje ma lngas mchod nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ 'di dngos gzhi gnyis pa man la mi dgos/ de nas lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ sogs nas/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ces pa'i bar sta gon ltar brjod/ de nas las kyi slob mas spos dang mar me sbar la/ mchod pa byin rlabs sa lha ltar byas te/ lha so so'i sngags kyi rjes la/ ar+ghaṃ btags pas mchod yon rkang thon du phul nas rdo dril 'dzin pas de nyid lnga pas bstod la/ slar mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa ni/ rang zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba'i lus gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du aṃ las mchod yon ma dkar mo/ zhes pa nas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / slar mchod pa rnams sa lha ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'di/ /sogs nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes bstod pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ nang mchod 'bul ba'i sngon du bdud rtsi byin rlabs gtor chog ltar byas nas gtor snod kyi 'og tu zhes pa bzhag la 'bul/ bstod pa'i mjug tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa brgya rtsa dang / oṃ āḥdzi na dzika oṃ hūm̐/ nas/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ gi bar sgrub thabs kyi ngag bzlas bzhin lan gsum re bzlas pa'i mthar/ thun mong du yi ge brgya pa dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ci nus bzlas la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/

zhes dang / rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kha nas rdo rje 'chang phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bye ste/ rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas rang gi gnas su 'khod/ ces brjod/ de nas sgrub grogs shig dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ rang sgrub khang gi phyi rol du phyin tu gong du 'dus byas pa'i phyi rol gtor ma bsham ste/ de yang stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ dbus su maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bcu dbus kyi rgyab tu gcig ste/ bkod pa bzhag de'i g.yas phyogs su mchod yon me tog gdug spos gsum/ g.yon du mar me dri chab zhal zas gsum/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyab tu gtor ma che ba sha dang sgog btsong la phug sogs kyis brgyan pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du chang gtsang ma rnams bsham/ gtor ma'i mdun gyi chang phud dang / chu gtsang mas sbyangs/ de nas slob dpon gyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor la gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ shar gyi tshom bu'i steng du dbang po ser skya glang po che la gnas pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa nas phyi rol gtor ma'i skabs 'dir mtshams rnams la me dang / bden bral dang / rlung dang / dbang ldan sogs mi gsung bar shar lho'i tshom bu'i steng du zhes sogs nas/ dbang ldan gyi tshom bu'i steng du zhes pa'i bar mtshams rnams rang ming nas brjod pa gsung rgyun yin/ dbus kyi tshom bu'i steng du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la gnas pa/ rgyab kyi tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/ sogs zhal phyag bskyed la/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor du lha klu sogs nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur/ ces pa'i bar dang / oṃ dā sha di ka nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar sta gon gyi gtor chog bzhin byas la/ phyogs skyong ba chen po khyed rnams zhes sogs nas/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang sdongs grogs mdzod cig

ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar brjod/ de'i bar la las slob kyis lha bshos bshams nas rim gyis gtor snod du blug mchod yon gyi chu phyed tsam gtor ma la bskor nas bran la/ lhag 'gro phyogs su gtor te yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sarba duṣ+ṭan gats+tsha zhes dang / rdo rje gsor/ dril bu dang rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor ro/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rting mnan te nang du 'ong nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgor chab blangs shing kha bshal la dkyil 'khor gyi drung du slebs pa dang rol mo bzhag rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad du gyur/ ces dang / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ sogs/ hūm̐ bzhi pa dang / yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing / dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi phyi nas dril bsil rol mo dang bcas pas skor ba lan gsum byas la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs nas/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol zhes dang / dngos 'di la bcol dril dang tshar gsum mdzad/ grub dril bsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba/ /thar pa'i grong du bcom ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyis/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hos rab tu grub par mdzod/

/ces dang 'og gi dkyil 'khor la me tog 'bul ba'i skabs bzhin/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ sha sho ta me bha wa hṛ da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho/ oṃ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ pra tits+tsha ku su me añdza liṃ nā tha hoḥ zhes brjod de dkyil 'khor la me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa twaṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes pas rang gi mgo la bcings par bsam/ de nas badz+ra ud+gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pa lan bzhi brjod la khro bo'i lta stangs kyis bltas pas nang nas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi dbye bar bsams la/ rdo dril 'dzin bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la phyag byas nas/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig ces brjod nas gral la 'khod/ dngos gzhi gnyis pa man la skabs 'dir bum bskyed mdzad/ de nas bdag 'jug gi chas rnams mdun du 'dus byas te/ bla ma'i bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis byas par bsams la/ las bum gyi chus gdong bkru ba'am cung zad cig 'thungs la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal dbul dus thog mtha' gnyis la tshig rgyas pa brjod cing / gzhan rnams la maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung zhig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyis dbul ba las/ thog mar/ 'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ nas/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dhā ba rā ma na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gdong bcings par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rjes zlos byas par mos la/ dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba/ /sogs brjod/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog 'phreng ba gtad/ kyai dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ /zhes dris/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang la'o/ /zhes lan btab/ dkon mchog gsum la/ sogs dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /sogs rgyun bshags dang /

rigs lnga'i sdom gzung sgrub thabs bzhin tshar gsum re brjod/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mi zhes rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying khar reg ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsid+dha badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes dang / oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / yol ba'i nang du bcug sa mā ya satwaṃ zhes pas lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa sems ma rdo rje mas phyag rgyas bzung / yang phyag rgya de nyid me tog dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ satwa badz+ri a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ hūm̐/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ ces brjod cing phan yon dang / 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang gong gi phyag rgya snying khar bzhag la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/

/zhes pa gnyis kyis nyes dmigs dang / dung chos kyi chu oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsngags pa 'thungs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsregs par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥzhes pas gnyis ka dang / de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla mas rang gi lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung bar bsams te/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod de/ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ shu n+yā tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ thams cad stong pa 'od gsal 'khor 'das de bzhin nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar hūm̐ sngon po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa yig 'bru gsum dang pad+ma yas mar thim/ nyi ma mas yar thim ste thams cad 'dus pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bur gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad bsdus nas zla ba la thim pas rang gi sems 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ dharmā dha tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zla ba'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te yig 'bru gsum la thim pas pad+ma dmar po oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/

pad+ma āt+ma ko3haṃ/ pad+ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas dang pos thugs khar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ g.yas lhag mas rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon lhag mas rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i spyi bor haṃ/ lkog mar āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros rnam snang 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa rnams spyan drangs rang la thim pas spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi lus kyi nang thams cad khong stong du gyur pa'i rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yi ge dzhai ཾdmar po/ de las byung ba'i me'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer rkang mthil nas zhugs te spyi gtsug gi bar du phyin pas lus thams cad sbyangs shing sems 'od gsal bar gyur/ yang snying khar hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgrin par āḥlas 'od dpag med/ mgo bor hā las rnam snang yum dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams dzhaiṃ ཾ'od kyis bskul bas yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun babs pas lus gang bar gyur/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rang gi snying khar bzhag la/ 'di khyod dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba/ /rdo rje'i ye shes bla na med/ /de nyid khyod la 'bebs par mdzad/ /oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes bcu nas brgya'i bar brjod la dbab/ rdo rje spyi bor bzung la yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig brjod pas brtan par bsam/ bdag 'jug la spogs chog dang rol mo mi dgos/ nam mkha'i kha dog dris nas dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs su skor ba byas par bsam pa tsam gyis chog

dril bu gsil zhing gdangs dang bcas pas/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ sngar gyi me tog trāṃ las rin po che'i me tog dang / rang gi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsams la/ de'i 'od kyis sdig pa thams cad dag par mos nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu steng du phul bar mos/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi dho me bha wa/ sha sho to me bha ba/ hṛ da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ oṃ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ pra tits+tsha ku su ma añdza liṃ nā thā hoḥ zhes brjod/ bla mas me tog mgo la bcings te 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur bar bsams la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa satwaṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes dang / rang gi mig gnyis su oṃ re/ snying khar hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ bsams la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur par/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /ces pas mig ras phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ /khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma rtse rol pas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis/ /he badz+ra pā sh+ya zhes pas dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mthong bar mos la/ de dag gi rnam dag bshad pa ste/ 'phags pa'i bden bzhi ngos bzhir 'gyur/ /tshangs pa'i gnas ni grwa yin no/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po zhes bya sgo/ /bzhi yi ming can re re ste/

/dad pa'i dbang po la sogs sems/ /rnam pa lnga po yang dag 'byung / /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi sgo khyud ni/ /bzhi ste de'ang rnam pa bzhi/ /de yi dbus kyi 'khor lo gang / /dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi gzhal ba ni/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yin no/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa'i/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad ces bya bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi khang chen du/ /thams cad tshe na ka bar 'gyur/ /chos dang de nyid don gyi brda'/ /'khor lo'i nang gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di de ni/ /thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /de nas 'khor lo'i bdag po nas/ /brtsams te gnod mdzes mthar thug lha/ /de bzhin de nyid du gnas rnams/ /rdo rje can gyi slob mar bshad/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas lnga rnams rab bstan bya/ /spyan ma la sogs lha mo bzhi/ /sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de nas 'dod yon lnga'i ngo bor/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs pa'o/ /mig la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du/ /sa yi snying po la sogs so/ /lag sogs ngo bor khro dbang po/ /gshin rje'i dgra sogs bstan par bya/ /de nas yul 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mi bskyod sogs rim bzhin/ /de ltar na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di'i rnam par dag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod cing bsams/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar du khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi dkar dmar nag pa'i ra ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ 'phar ma gnyis pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i 'dab ma rnams la shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri/ snam bu rnams la dbang bskur ba'i bum pa sogs dgod/ lte ba'i steng du rin po che'i shing gi khri la bdag nyid 'dug par mos pa tsam byas pas chog bdag 'jug gi tshe bskyed pa sogs mi dgos/

de nas/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ rū pa sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas bye ba'i bgegs mthar byed kyis sbyang ba rnams mdzad par bsam ste/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod de yungs kar dang chu la bsngags nas sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swāhā/ tshar gsum/ zhes brjod cing g.yon dang g.yas su lan gnyis re bskor ba dang byab pa'i tshul bya/ chus kyang sbyang ba byas la/ oṃ tshar gsum/ hūm̐ ḍa d+bhi ta phaṭ/ ces dang / oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pra wā ra sad ka ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūm̐ dang / hūm̐ zhes pa'i bdug spos te/ bdag 'jug gi dus mchod pa 'di rnams la phyag rgya tsam gyis chog par sems so/ /de nas rang la bigh+nān+ta kṛta dang las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te/ dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa/ oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas 'dod chags chen po'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas nang dbang bskur te/ lha mo'i pad+ma nas phyir thon nas dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod pa'i lus kyi mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon bzhi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ rlung rgyu ba'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ sna rtse bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ rlung lnga ni rtsig pa lnga/ lce'i rnam shes rin chen pha gu/ rgyu ma dra ba/ rgyus pa dra ba phyed pa/ byang sems dkar po zla phyed/ mig gi rnam shes me long / rna ba'i rnam shes ba dan/ sna'i rnam shes me tog gi 'phreng ba/ lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan/ mig rta babs kyi steng gi chos kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan ma/ yid kyi rnam shes ri dgas/ sna rta babs la gnas pa'i ba dan/ lce dril bu/ rna ba sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang zur gyi rdo rje rin po che/ lus kyi tshigs rnams rnga yab la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ yid dbang dbus kyi pad+ma lte ba bum pa ste rnam snang gi lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ/ mgrin par 'du byed kyi ngo bo āḥ snying khar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐/ lte bar tshor ba'i ngo bo swā/ brla rtsar 'du byed kyi ngo bo hā/ lte bar sa khams kyi ngo bo laṃ/ snying khar chu khams kyi ngo bo maṃ/ mgrin par me khams kyi ngo bo paṃ/ spyi bor rlung khams kyi ngo bo taṃ/ mig tu mig dbang gi ngo bo thalīṃ/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/

snar sna'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ lcer lce'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ snying khar yid dbang gi ngo bo hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sgor lus dbang gi ngo bo oṃ/ tshigs mtshams rnams su tshigs mtshams kyi ngo bo saṃ/ spyi gtsug tu rtsa rgyus kyi ngo bo maiṃ/ mig gi sgor gzugs kyi ngo bo dzaḥ rna bar sgra'i ngo bo hūm̐/ snar dri'i ngo bo baṃ/ lcer ro'i ngo bo hoḥ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya'i ngo bo khaṃ/ lag pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ khar kha'i ngo bo hūm̐/ rdo rjer rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐/ dpung pa g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ spyi bor spyi bo'i ngo bo hūm̐/ pus mo g.yas par g.yas pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ g.yon par g.yon pa'i ngo bo hūm̐/ rkang mthil gnyis su rkang mthil gyi ngo bo hūm̐ ste rang gi phung kham/ skye mched thams cad lha'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrdo rje ma lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs khar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes brjod/ dbang rdzas/ bigh+nān+ta dang las bum gyi chus bsang / shu n+yā tas sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyi/ mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug nas g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyi/ gong bzhin bskyed/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sogs ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ zhes 'og ma thams cad la'ang sbyar ro/ /'di yang ma chad pa dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis gsang 'dus kyi yi ge rnying pa rnams mthong nas bris pa yin pas/

sgrub byed logs na bris yod pas ma go ba'i gtam ma smra zhig spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ sogs sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra ta twaṃ a haṃ/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ oṃ bai ro tsa na ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar dang / rdo dril 'dzin pas/ rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing bstod de rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ ces brjod/ rnam rgyal bum pa btegs la dril bu gsil la/ til gyi gang bu ltar gang ba'i/ /rgyal ba bum pa 'dzin pa yis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /de ltar shes nas yid bder gyis/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka ṇa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti twe no pa ḍi ḍho me bhā wa/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje/ /ma lus sems can skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshan gsol de yis ni/ /sdang bas zil gnon skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa/ /bkra shis༞ bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing / /rmongs pas zil mnan skye bo༞ bkra shis༞ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan/ /phongs pa'i sdug bsngal grol bar yongs su rab brtson zhing /

/khengs pas zil mnan skye bo༞ bkra shis༞ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan/ /'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po/ /chags pas zil mnan skye bo༞ bkra shis༞ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spong / /phrag dog zil mnan skye bo rnam par sbyong byed pa/ /bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur/ /zhes brjod/ de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra ta twaṃ a haṃ/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā laṃ maṃ nas hūm̐ bcu'i bar gyi lha rnams kyi sa bon tsam brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis gang / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib rnams dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa rnam snang gi rnam pas mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon nas rang la thim zhes brjod/ ai bai ro tsa na ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shap+da'i bar gyis mchod cing dril sil bya/ de ltar na dbang dgu las rnam par snang mdzad chu'i dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /cho ga'i rnam dbye 'di nges par byas la/ 'og ma rnams la 'di'i rigs 'gre sbyar ro/ /de nas rang nyid dbang stegs las langs te gos gsar pa gyon/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pas gdugs dkar po bzung la rdo rje'i glu blangs shing dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas par bsam ste lag pa g.yon de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa'i mthe bo'i steng du/

g.yas thal mo kha phub la des bskor ba'i tshul gyi gdugs kyi phyag rgya dang / ngag tu/ bde ba chen po 'dod chags che/ /rdo rje chen po nor che ba/ /shes rab chen po ye shes che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag sgrub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje che/ /dngos grub kun gyi bde ster ba/ /kun gyis dbang bskur bskur don du/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal/ /thar pa nor chos 'dod pa ster mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes lnga dang dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal/ /mgon po bde chen phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ /zhes rdo rje'i glu blang ngo / /rin 'byung la/ bigh+nān sogs kyis bsangs pa nas/ lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa sogs gong bzhin la/ swā las rin po che swā yis mtshan pa las rin 'byung ser po/ sogs kyis bskyed/ gtso bo'i thugs kha'i sogs nas/ lus kyi mdun rgyab dang zhes sogs kyi bar gong bzhin las/ rin 'byung gi lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i spyi bor gzugs phung sogs nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rin 'byung gi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes sogs dang / dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las swā las rin po che swā yis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ rat+na sam+bha wa ar+ghaṃ sogs dang / rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mchod cing bstod de rin 'byung zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbu rgyan thogs la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ /sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa pu dza ya a ti swā ma mi ā hūm̐/ zhes pas dbu rgyan gyon/ de nas lag gnyis rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mthe bong gnyis bsnol/

gung mo gshibs pa'i tshigs bar par mdzub mo gnyis btsugs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi phyag rgya spyi gtsug tu bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra dhā tu i shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes dang sngar gyi sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dang / sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya las gung mo'i tshigs dbus ma bcag rin po che 'dra ba'i rin chen rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yas par bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ zhes dang / de nyid las gung mo pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa rdo rje chos kyi phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ dharmā badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥde nyid las gung mo'i rtse mo bcag pa las kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon par bzhag la/ oṃ karma badz+ri a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ spyi bor mi bskyod pa/ dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad/ rna ltag g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par gyur/ ces dang dar dpyangs byin zhing / oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥzhes dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pas gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa rin 'byung gi rnam pas mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du …byon nas rang la thim/ oṃ rat+na saṃ bhā wa ar+ghaṃ sogs dang / de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /'od dpag med la/ bigh+nān gyis bsangs pa nas/ lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa ā las pad+ma ās mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po sogs dang /

'od dpag med kyi lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sogs 'dra/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sogs dang / dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ā las pad+ma as mtshan pa las 'od dpag med/ sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ a mi tā bha wa ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar dang / rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mchod cing bstod de/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ rdo rje thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /legs par grub phyir rdo rje zungs/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /dngos grub mchog phyir rdo rje longs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis khyod la stsol/ /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rdo rje'i dbang dang / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /zhes brjod la rdo rje snying kha/ mgrin pa/ spyi bor reg la/ gtso bo bla ma'i rjes zlos mdzad par bsam zhing / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha e ka twaṃ dha ra ya mi satwa hi hi/ rdo rje gsor la snying khar bzung ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /de nas sangs rgyas rdo rje sogs kyis gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams la dbang lha gnyis pa 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas sogs dang / a mṛ ta sogs kyis mchod nas/

de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /don yod grub pa la/ bigh+nān gyis bsangs ba nas/ lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa hāḥlas ral gri hās mtshan pa las don yod grub pa ljang khu sogs dang / don yod grub pa'i lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa sogs 'dra/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad don yod grub pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sogs dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hāḥlas ral gri hās mtshan pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ā mo gha sid+dhi ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+da'i bar dang / don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes mchod cing bstod/ don yod grub pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ dril bu thogs la/ zla ba'i 'od can ye shes sku lnga rgyal ba'i cod pan 'dzin pa pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gdug pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i don du srid gsum ma lus 'dul mdzad sdigs pa'i rdo rje can/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bskul phyir de kho na nyid so sor sgrog pa'i chos nyid dril bu 'khrol/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bo ma lus ston pa'i bcom ldan gang yin de ni rgyal gyur cig /me long gi ni gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang / /mig 'phrul 'dra ba sus mthong ba/ /de ni mnga' bdag tu bzhed do/ /zhes brjod cing dril bu dkrol la dku g.yon pa'i phyogs su bkan te bzung / rdo rje snyems ma'i tshul gyis thugs khar bzung la rjes zlos byas par bsam zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig gi rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe a a/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/

/bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod/ /ces dang / gtso bos gsung bar bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥs ma ya satwaṃ zhes dang / de nas sangs rgyas rdo rje sogs kyis gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa don yod grub pa'i rnam pas sogs dang / a mo gha sid+dhi ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la/ bigh+nān gyis bsangs pa nas/ lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kha'i sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sogs 'dra/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sogs dang / dbang rdzas mig thur dang me long mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las mig thur āḥlas rdo rje ās mtshan pa las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dang / me long hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis ka'ang sku mdog dkar ba/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum sogs zhal phyag snga ma ltar bskyed/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad shes phyin dang rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par sogs nas/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ dbang bskur gnyis char la rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ pradzñā pa ra mi ta badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ sogs dang / 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gyur gang / /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod/

/'gro ba'i mi shes cod pan can/ /dag pa'i de nyid don ston mdzad/ /bdag med chos las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces mchod cing bstod de/ shes phyin dang rdo rje sems dpa' zhu ba las byung ba'i mig thur dang me long du gyur/ rdo rje'i mig thur thogs la/ thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /zhes dang / me long gnang bar bsams la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes dang / me long rdo rje gnang bar bsams la/ āḥbadz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag gang / /byang chub sems 'di shes par gyis/ /thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje 'chang chen po dang / rang gi sems dbyer med du shes par gyis shig ces dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje sogs kyis gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ de ltar na rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas me long gi dbang thob/ yul yul can gyi dri ma dag chos dang chos nyid gnas gyur/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems mngon du byas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / de'i rigs kyi dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /mi bskyod pa la bigh+nān gyis bsangs pa nas/ lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po sogs kyis bskyed pa nas/

mi bskyod pa'i lus rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sogs dang / sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim pa'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ sogs brjod/ dbang rdzas bskyed chog mi dgos pas/ rdor dril lhan cig mgo bor bkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje ta thā ga ta sa ma ya sid+dha sa ma ya twaṃ bhur+bhu wa swa/ zhes brjod la che ge mo'i gnas su/ dpal mi bskyod rdo rje sogs la gras pa'i ming btags nas/ rdo dril bzhag la/ gdod shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal dang cha lugs su bsgyur te/ g.yon chos gos kyi grwa 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ 'dir ni khyed rnams ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams la ston/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya twaṃ bhur+bhu ba swa/ gang la phyag rgya 'dis lung bstan pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /zhes dang g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyar bsgyur te/ mahā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol te/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyi nas 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams las grol/ /byang chub sems ni nam mi spang / /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig bskyed pa nyid tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/

/dam pa'i chos la smad mi bya/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa yi gti mug gis/ /rnam par bstan par bya ma yin/ /rdo rje dang ni dril bu dang / /phyag rgya'ang nam yang smad mi bya/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid yongs btang ste/ /dka' thub kyis kyang gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bas bde bzung na/ /'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de ring bdud rnams pham byas nas/ /grong khyer dam par rab tu zhugs/ /deng dus khyed kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces brjod la dbugs dbyung / de nas/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sogs kyis gong bzhin chu dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas/ sogs dang / oṃ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa dang de la brten pa'i dngos grub thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ /phyag mtshan gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi bdag nyid khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang dang 'khor lo gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang dbang rdzas 'khor lo oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo/ rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rnam snang gi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pa'i spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po sogs brjod/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra ta twaṃ a haṃ/ zhes bdag dang dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas 'khor lor gyur/ ces brjod cing 'khor lo len tshul dang / sems can kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /dza ya dza ya sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti pra warta ya dharmā tsakra zhes brjod/ cho ga'i rigs 'gres 'di 'og ma gsum la'ang sbyar te/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rin 'byung du bskyed pa gong bzhin rin po che len tshul yan dang / sems can kun sogs tshig dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dzñā na a bhi ṣai ka ta pra brta oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes dang / rang dang dbang rdzas pad+ma 'od dpag med du bskyed pa gong bzhin pad+ma len tshul yan dang / tshig dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra dharmā sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dzñā na rā ga pad+ma ra la swa bha wa hriḥ.āḥ bdag dang dbang rdzas sna tshogs rdo rje don grub tu bskyed pa gong bzhin/ sna tshogs rdo rje len tshul dang tshig dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra karma sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dzñā na sarba pū dza swa bhā wa āḥ bdag po'i dbang ni rang la bigh+nān+ta kṛta dang / las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs te dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dkyil 'khor gyis gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas lha mo'i pad+mar thon pa hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje 'chang sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma sngon po/

g.yon dril bu/ rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi lus rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i spyi bor gzugs phung gi ngo bo oṃ/ zhes sogs rnam snang bzhin dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par sogs kyis spyan drangs te mchod la bstim/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ de 'od du zhu ba las rdo rjer gyur/ ces brjod la rdo rje bzung ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pa dang / thog mtha' med pa'i sogs 'od dpag med kyi skabs bzhin brjod la/ rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /ces pa'i mjug la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /zhes brjod cing thugs khar bzung ba rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas dril bu ās mtshan pa las rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo/ de 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ ces brjod la dril bu bzung ste/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces dril bu dkrol te dku g.yon par kha gyen du phyogs pas bzung la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod pas dril bu gsung gi dam tshig yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bshad/ /lus kun brtan par byed pas na/ /de phyir phyag rgya zhes su grags/ /rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/

'khyud rgya byas la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod pa phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ste dam tshig gsum byin pa'o/ /gong rigs lnga'i skabs bzhin chu dbang bskur te/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad rang la thim/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rang gi spyi bor me tog gtor/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis longs/ /gzhan gyi chung ma bsten par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya 'o/ /slob dpon brnyas par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang brnyas pa/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob par 'gyur/ /de phyir sangs rgyas 'bras 'dod cing / /gus dang ldan pa'i sems can gyis/ /bsam pas 'bras bu stsol ba po/ /'di la 'bad pa kun gyis mchod/ /byang chub go 'phang bla 'am ci/ /srid pa sel bar su yis nus/ /gang la skye zhing 'chi ba med/ /gang zhig las gnyis la nus ldan/ /rdo rje slob dpon med par ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad spong ba dang / /mya ngan 'das zhi go 'phang dang / /phyir mi ldog pa thob mi 'gyur/ /rang gi dam tshig rtag tu sgrubs/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la dbul byed/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan sems kyis/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /rtag tu rnam rtog med gyur na/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa lnga rnams spyod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun gsungs shing / /bka' lung dam pa brtag par gyis/ /dam tshig dang ni ldan pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/

/zhes brjod/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol/ /gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa byung rang gi khar zhugs ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' skor du 'khod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ swā āḥhā hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas/ gtso bo bla ma la me tog phul bar bsam/ la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod/ /ces dang / gtso bos rang gi spyi bor bzhag par bsams la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod pas sngags kyi dngos grub thob par bsam pa rnams ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang mtha' brten dang bcas pa'o/ /lha la yon dbul ba'i cho ga ni/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha grangs dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥnut+tā ra sarba pū dza me gha sa mut+ga te s+pha ra i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes brjod la gos zung phul/ de nas bla ma la yon dbul ba'i cho ga ni slob mas bla ma la ci 'byor ba'i yon phul la/ gtso bo bla mas gsungs par bsams te/ yul dang yid 'ong chung ma dang / /rin po che dang gser 'bar dang / /nor bu mu tig byu ru dang / /lus po yang ni dbul ba sogs/ /de nyid mi zad par 'dod pas/ /gang gang ci yang ches yid du/ /'ong dang ches khyad 'phags pa nyid/ /de de bla ma la dbul bya/ /slob dpon lha ni dam pa ste/ /'bad pa'i sgo nas mchod par 'os/ /'jig rten rjes bzung rgyu nyid kyis/ /de nyid de lta'i gzugs can no/ /gang gis bla ma rdo rje 'dzin/ /tha dad nyid du mthong gyur pa/ /de yi de nyid dngos grub ni/ /tshogs pa'i mtshan nyid can mi thob/ /mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma'i mchod pa yang dag brtsam/

/de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog de thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig bskal pa bye bar ni/ /brgya phrag tu yang rnyed dka' ba/ /de nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan la/ /skye ba 'di la stsol bar mdzad/ /ces brjod cing spro ba bskyed par bsam/ rang skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ 'phreng ba la sogs dbang rnams kyis/ /dbang bskur nga yis byin pa yis/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdun na gnas/ /da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon ste/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsam/ /khyod ni bdud rnams las rgyal te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /seṅge'i spyod pa legs spyad pas/ /khyod kyis sems can don rnams byos/ /chos rnams kun la ser sna dang / /sems can kun la mi phan gang / /nyam nga shin tu che na yang / /bu khyod kyis ni de mi bya/ /'di la the tshom mi bya ste/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog /mnyam med khyod kyis bsgrag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor legs par bri bya ste/ /slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su/ /slob ma rnams la dbang bskur yang / /brtul zhugs brtan pas 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrubs/ /de nyid rig pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dngos grub de rnams thams cad 'byung / /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam tshig rnams kyang bskyang bar bya/ /khyod rtag bla ma gus pa yis/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thogs drin du gzo zhes brjod/ /des na byas pa gzo ba yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang khyod la bsrung / /zhes brjod pa rjes su gnang ba byin pa'o/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim yan lag dang bcas pa bsgom pa la dbang /

'bras bu sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ /gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' theg pa che/ /nam mkha'i spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i mchog /rgyal mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /rdo rje theg pa rab ston pa/ /nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa'i mchog /rgyal bzhi mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /thar pa'i lam ni rab ston pa/ /theg pa gsum gyi lam na gnas/ /sangs rgyas skal mchog dag pa'i bdag /mi mchog mchod pa bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems ni rgyas pa'i spyan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni shin tu dag /phyag 'tshal rdo rje theg pa la'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ tsak+ṣur ban+dha wā ra ma ṇa ya hūm̐/ gis gdong bcings/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bo sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi bdag nyid can yum reg rdo rje ma dang bcas pa gnyis ka'ang rigs lnga la sogs pa lha'i tshogs pa can du gyur pa'i yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i rtse mor oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs te spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes zhu nas byang chub kyi sems su gyur te pad+mar babs pa rang gi lce thog tu gnang / 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūm̐ hūm̐ a ho su kha/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myangs pas lus thams cad gang / rang bzhin brgyad cu'i dri ma dag stong pa gsum gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing cung zad mnyam par gzhag go

/de nas byang sems lhag ma dung chos su bum chu dang bsres pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsngags te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ spyi bor gtugs shing / bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sogs sh+lau ka gcig gong bzhin dang / pad+ma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab byung ste/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dbu ni shin tu skam pa la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung ba'i ye shes chu/ /dri med rin chen char gyis spyi bor dbang skur cig /ces brjod cing dung chos kyi chu 'thungs la/ rang nyid 'od dpag med du gyur/ /ces dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mig ras phye/ de ltar na dkyil 'khor bzhi las lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / sems dben bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ /shes rab ye shes zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gong bzhin tsak+ṣus gdong bcings/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po yin/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa dpang por byas ste/ rig ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtag /'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gi ni sems/ /nor bu'i nang du gson ltas pas/ /thabs gzhan gyi ni sangs mi rgya/ /de bas rig ma 'di mchog yin/ /chos kun gnyis su med pa la/ /dngos po gnyis su brtags pa yin/ /de bas 'khor ba rnams bral bar/ /rtag tu khyod kyis mi bya 'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla med pa'o/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'das gyur na/ /de yis dngos grub mchog mi 'grub/

/zhes brjod cing rig ma gnang bar bsam/ rig ma des kyang lus dri zhim po byugs/ gos dang bral bas rang gi chu skyes ston cing / e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /twaṃ bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod par bsams/ rang nyid thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang / rig ma reg rdo rjer gyur pa gnyis ka'ang rigs lnga la sogs pa lha'i tshogs pa can du gyur pa'i yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa rtse mor oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pas rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer lngas gang ste slar rin 'byung du gyur/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas byang sems nor bu'i bar du khyab par bsams la/ rdo rje pad+mar rab gnas te/ /byang chub sems kyang spang mi bya/ /bskyod bya de yi dga' ba yis/ /sems ni kun tu gang bar bsgom/ /rnal 'byor pas ni byang chub sems/ /ji srid ma dor de srid du/ /rgyun mi chad pa dga' ba las/ /byung ba'i bde ba cis mi thob/ /ces brjod/ de nas rig ma'i brtul zhugs byin par bsams la/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /bla na med pa'i don byos shig /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yis/ /'di ni man ngag las ni shes/ /rig pa 'di ni dor byas nas/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya/ /brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yis spyod/ /de ltar 'di ni rnal 'byor mchog /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor la/ /rim pa ji bzhin yongs shes nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang bstan/

/ces dang / bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal la/ /ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bus stsal/ /sems can kun la ci 'dod par/ /dngos grub bla na med pa stsal/ /zhes lan btab cing gtang rag phul bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yog bsal/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu thugs rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ /dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ tsak+ṣus gdong bcings/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa'i mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes brjod/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral bar nges shes bskyed do/ /de mngon du byed pa'i thabs rang nyid lha sku sgyu ma lta bu phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i rnam thar sgo gsum gyi stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du nyams su myong ba dang dbyer med du shes par byas la cung zad mnyam par gzhag de nas/ e ma hoḥsangs rgyas e ma ho chos/ /chos bshad pa ni ngo mtshar che/ /yang dag don ni dag pa'i don/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med pa yi chos las byung / /sangs rgyas byang chub rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs su med/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu bzang po thams cad don/ /byang chub sems ni rab bskor ba/ /byang chub spyod mchog rdo rje mchog /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/
