/dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab ston pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing bzhi pa'i don la yid ches pa'i gtang rag dbul lo/ /'bru gsum brjod cing gdong g.yog bkrol/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lam zung 'jug gi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ /de nas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bya'o snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / dbang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /gtso bos bdag ni mchod par bzhes/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i don du thal mo sbyar nas/ 'od gsal ba las yang dag byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni dpe yang ste/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni de dang mtshungs/ /bden pa 'di yis slob ma rnams/ /thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu bzhugs/ /'khor lo'i rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa/ /mthong na sdig pa mtha' dag spong / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam tshig dran par byas pa las/ /zhugs pas de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol/ /ces lan gsum brjod cing gsol ba btab/ de nas sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ 'das gtor dang sgos kyi chos skyong dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phul nas slob ma dbang bskur dgos na zur du bris pa'i sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor ltar 'dir bya'o// ༈ //spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas phyi mchod/

rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de nyid lngas bstod pa rnams sta gon bzhin byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi mthar sgrub mchod snga ma rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/ rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ oṃ sū pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ gzhan brtan bzhugs dgos pa rnams skabs dang sbyar la bya/ gtor mgron gyi rten med pa rnams la gshegs gsol bsngo ba bkra shis sogs sta gon gyi skabs bzhin byed/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ mchod pa dbul ba'i sngon du bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khyams kyi steng du spyan drangs/ de nas mchod pa rnams gong bzhin dang / yig brgya mang du bzla/ de'i tshe slob mas mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdus la/ gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas rjes/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdul tshon dang / bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams spyan drangs/ rang gi phung po lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga/ khams bzhi la yum bzhi/ mig sogs la sems dpa' sems ma/ tshigs chen bcu la khro bo bcu/ lus kyi cha shas so so la rten gyi dkyil 'khor rnams thim pas rang nyid lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum du gyur te/

de dag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros te sems can thams cad la dbang bskur nas sgrib pa dag nas hūm̐ yig tu gyur pa des nam mkha'i khams gang ba yongs su gyur pa las sems can thams cad rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ de rnams rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs nas rang nyid la thim/ zhes brjod nas gong ltar gtor mgron gshegs gsol byas la rol mo dang bcas pas a kā ro sogs brjod cing des rdul tshon bsubs la mtshan ma spyi bor bzhag thig rjes phyi ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gong bzhin smon lam btab la/ dge legs yon tan gter mnga' 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rdo rje 'chang bdag dpal ldan rdo rje chos/ /yon tan brgyad ldan klu sgrub rdo rje can/ /'phags pa lha dang shākya bshes gnyen zhabs/ /klu yi byang chub zla ba grags pa sogs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /bde chen 'gyur med zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsang gsum 'dus pa'i rang bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /rgyal ba bskyed mdzad dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag /khyab bdag drug pa dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /rigs kun bdag po'i bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /rmad byung chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba mi bskyod reg bya rdo rjer bcas/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur/ /khro bo'i dbang po gnod mdzes rgyal po sogs/ /khyab bdag thugs las sprul pa lha yi tshogs/ /rdo rje rigs kyi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /rnam dag me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/

/rnam par snang mdzad spyan ma gzugs rdo rje/ /byams pa sa yi snying po gshin rje'i dgra /gdug pa kun 'dul mi g.yo mgon la sogs/ /khyab bdag sku las sprul pa lha yi tshogs/ /'khor lo'i rigs kyi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /chos kun mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rin 'byung mā ma kī dang sgra rdo rje/ /phyag rdor nam snying shes rab mthar byed dpal/ /bgegs kun tshar gcod 'dod pa'i rgyal po sogs/ /khyab bdag yon tan las sprul lha yi tshogs/ /rin chen rigs kyi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu༞ chos dang༞ rgyal ba'i sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /'od dpag med mgon gos dkar dri rdo rje/ /'jig rten dbang phyug pad+ma mthar byed bcas/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can la sogs/ /khyab bdag gsung las sprul pa lha yi tshogs/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang༞ mtha' yas bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /don yod grub dang sgrol ma ro rdo rje/ /kun bzang sgrib pa rnam sel bgegs mthar byed/ /bdud dpung zil gnon stobs po che la sogs/ /khyab bdag 'phrin las sprul pa lha yi tshogs/ /ral gri'i rigs kyi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang༞ byang chub phyogs chos tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba'i bsti gnas rin chen gzhal yas khang / /rgya chen 'od gsal bkod legs dbyibs mdzes pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i khang bzang mchog /bdud las rnam rgyal srung ba'i 'khor lo bcas/ /pho brang mchog gi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye dgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dang / gzhan yang yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis rgyas par brjod la me tog gi char dbab cing rol mo'i sgra cher bya'//ོ

༈ //'dir smras pa/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje yi/ /sgrub dkyil lhan cig bsdebs pa'i bstan chos 'di/ /blo gsal mtha' dag 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir/ /lugs 'dir yun ring sbyangs pa'i sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /cho ga'i phyag len rnam dag rgyun bzang po/ /'phel ba'i rkyen du gyur na ci ma rung / /snyam pa'i lhag bsam dag pas legs par bsdebs/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyis 'di phyi'i don/ /yid bzhin 'grub nas spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan pa mchog tu 'phel ba'i mthu ldan shog /'di ltar bgyis pa'i yi ge'i 'du byed mkhan/ /rnam dpyod blo ldan mi dbang mtsho sgo ba/ /rnam rgyal rdo rje zhes bya ā k+ṣa ra'i/ /tshul la mkhas pa'i phul phyin gang de 'o/ /chos 'di thos bsam bgyid la bsrung ba dang / /kun tu 'phel ba zhing skyong dbang pos mdzod/ sarba dā oṃ/ thams cad bkra shis/ ka l+yā na bar+dhan+tu/ bde legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub dkyil phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
